question: What span of twenty-eight worlds is described, and which deities are said to be present there?
premises: Vidyā is described as having twenty-eight worlds.
This span extends from puruṣa to the end of night.
Hālāhala, Rudra, Krud, Ambikā, Aghorikā, and Vāmā are present there.
inference: The verse summarizes a twenty-eight-world span from puruṣa to niśānta and names key deities within it.
uncertainties: The exact interpretation of niśānta as a boundary term depends on the larger cosmological scheme.
plain_english: Vidyā has twenty-eight worlds, extending from puruṣa to the end of night. There are Hālāhala, Rudra, Krud, Ambikā, Aghorikā, and Vāmā.
